# CompleteConnectomeDynamics

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of how the full, experimentally mapped synaptic wiring of an organism's nervous system shapes its emergent neural activity patterns. Provides a benchmark for validating whether in-network neuromorphic architectures can reproduce biological dynamics from a known structural blueprint.
